title: Critical Inter-Horizon Thermal Dynamics on the Lukewarm Reissner-Nordström-de Sitter Manifold
summary: We reinterpret the lukewarm sector of four-dimensional Reissner--Nordström--de Sitter black holes as the exact zero-dissipation thermal manifold of an effective two-horizon nonequilibrium system. In the fixed-charge sector, the inter-horizon thermal affinity controls the entropy production and vanishes precisely on the lukewarm branch.
